about: Nava Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in ferroalloy manufacturing, energy, mining, agribusiness, and operation and maintenance services in India, Zambia, the United States, Hong Kong, Japan, the United Arab Emirates, and internationally. It operates through Ferro Alloys, Energy, Mining, and Other segments.
